issues.detail: The Greek 'εις το γενεσθαι υμας ετερω' means 'in order that you might become another' (referring to a new creation/being). The Vietnamese translation 'để anh em thuộc về người khác' translates this as 'so that you belong to another person,' which changes the ontological meaning of becoming a new being into a relational meaning of belonging to a different person.
